units.source_text: 那位檢察官四十歲上下，性情溫和（即使我長得英俊，也是那種帶有淫邪氣的英俊，

en.t: The prosecutor was around forty and gentle in temperament; even if I was handsome, mine was the sort of handsomeness tinged with something lewd and sinister,

units.source_text: 而這位警察的面孔堪稱標準的英俊，充滿著聰慧文靜的氣息），

en.t: while this prosecutor's face could truly be called properly handsome, full of an intelligent and quiet air,

units.source_text: 因為他看起來不像是凡事都斤斤計較的人，所以在他面前我沒起一點戒心，只是心不在焉地陳述。

en.t: Since he did not seem like the kind of person who fussed over every little thing, I felt no caution before him and simply gave my statement absentmindedly.

units.source_text: 突然的咳嗽，讓我從袖口中取出手帕，忽見上面的血跡，心中頓時浮現一個卑劣的念頭，

en.t: A sudden cough made me take a handkerchief from my sleeve; when I noticed the bloodstain on it, a vile thought immediately came to me,

units.source_text: 以為咳嗽或許可以作為我討價還價的籌碼，於是便誇張地高聲假咳兩下，

en.t: thinking that the cough might perhaps serve as a bargaining chip, I exaggeratedly let out two loud false coughs,

units.source_text: 再用手帕捂著嘴，偷偷瞥了一眼檢察官。「你是真的咳嗽嗎？」

en.t: then, covering my mouth with the handkerchief, I stole a glance at the prosecutor. Is that a real cough?
